<title level="1" right="Class Feature 19">[Hero's Defiance](/Classes.aspx?ID=4)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 104

**Class** Champion
</column>

---

You can defy fate and continue fighting as long as you have divine energy. You gain the [_hero’s defiance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=394) devotion spell.
